json_ld_descriptions: Zavodnick & Lasky Personal Injury Lawyers is a personal injury law firm serving Philadelphia, PA and the surrouding areas. We handle all personal injury cases including car accidents, dog bites, motorcycle accidents, wrongful death claims, and more. If you've been hurt in an accident, then call our personal injury lawyers today to find out how much your case is worth. We offer a free consultation and are available 24/7 to take your call.
Zavodnick & Lasky Personal Injury Lawyers are personal injury attorneys in Philadelphia PA.

Zavodnick & Lasky Personal Injury Lawyers is a premier law firm based in Philadelphia, PA, specializing in personal injury and workers’ compensation cases. With over 30 years in operation and 80+ years of combined legal experience, our team has helped thousands of injured clients seek justice and recover substantial compensation. Our attorneys are recognized across Pennsylvania for their dedication, aggressive representation, and proven results in cases involving car accidents, slip and falls, workplace injuries, medical malpractice, wrongful death, product liability, nursing home abuse, and more.

What sets Zavodnick & Lasky apart is our client-centered approach. Every case is personally handled by a seasoned attorney—not passed to an assistant or junior staff member. We believe injured victims deserve direct access to experienced legal counsel who will fight for their rights and communicate with honesty and transparency. From the first consultation, we work to understand your specific situation, assess your legal options, and aggressively pursue the compensation you deserve—whether that’s through settlement or trial.

We’ve secured millions in verdicts and settlements for our clients across a wide range of injury claims. Whether you’ve been hit by a negligent driver, injured on unsafe property, or suffered workplace trauma, our skilled team has the resources and expertise to protect your rights and maximize your recovery. We also specialize in navigating the complex Pennsylvania workers' compensation system, helping employees recover medical benefits and lost wages following an injury on the job.

Located conveniently at 123 S Broad St #1220 in Center City Philadelphia, we serve clients throughout the greater Philadelphia area and surrounding communities. Our attorneys are available for free consultations and operate on a contingency fee basis—meaning you don’t pay unless we win your case. As proud members of the local legal community, our firm has earned top ratings on platforms like Google, Yelp, and Avvo, and is consistently recommended by former clients and legal peers.

We are active in the Philadelphia community and believe in giving back by supporting safety initiatives, local causes, and educational efforts aimed at injury prevention. If you or a loved one has been injured due to someone else’s negligence, Zavodnick & Lasky Personal Injury Lawyers is here to help. With decades of experience, personalized service, and a commitment to justice, we are the trusted name in injury law for Pennsylvania residents.
